# CLAUDE.md rule map — supabase

**Generated by `scripts/gen-claude-rule-map.mjs` on the 2026-10-01 split.** 1220 rule
paragraphs enumerated from `docs/CLAUDE-HISTORY.md`, every one with a destination.

> **WHAT THIS PROVES, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT.** Destinations are assigned **per source section**
> from a declared table, not per paragraph. So this map proves **no section was dropped**, and
> it does **not** prove that each individual paragraph has its own line in the new file — that
> would need 1220 human judgements and the claim is not made here. Read a row as: *this
> paragraph's rule lives at the destination, or is an instance supporting a rule that does.*
>
> The generator asserts its own extraction was non-empty, that every section it found has a
> declared destination, and that every declared destination was actually found — so a stale
> table or a regex that stops matching exits 2 rather than reporting clean.
